# Funding asset provenance

This directory is reserved for official funding and project-emblem assets. It intentionally contains no local emblem, logo, or other image asset.

Before any asset is added, maintainers must supply and approve:

- the official file from the signed grant agreement or the consortium communication kit;
- the authoritative provenance for that file (for example, the issuing source, version or date, and checksum); and
- the official usage rules, including any required placement, sizing, attribution, or modification restrictions.


See [`doc/funding.md`](../../funding.md) for the verified metadata and the exact-contract-text blocker. Funding assets remain blocked for release while B-02 is unresolved.
